events.title: Color Factory Demo – Tutorial Progression Bug Fix
events.summary: Fixed an issue where node details did not appear during the tutorial, preventing players from progressing. The tutorial can now be completed normally. We apologize for the inconvenience.

events.title: Color Factory Demo v0.4.2 Update – Quest Progression Rework
events.summary: Color Factory Demo has been updated to v0.4.2! This update reworks quest completion and the early quest lineup so you can progress naturally using your existing factory. Quest Completion Rework Previously, you had to use dedicated Quest Nodes to make progress on quests. However, those nodes made it difficult to reuse an established factory, and we often saw players leave quests aside altogether. events.title: Color Factory Demo v0.4.1 Update – Bug Fixes & UI Readability Improvements
events.summary: Fixed First-Time Recipe Reward Display During the v0.4.0 update, the recipe-specific help system was removed. In the process, an issue occurred where the first-time recipe completion reward button remained visible even before the related quest had been unlocked. Because of this, even after completing a recipe, it could appear as though the recipe had not been completed if the related quest was still locked. events.title: Color Factory Demo v0.4.0 Update – Milestones, Balance & Controls
events.summary: Milestone System Added A new progression system, Milestones, has been added. Milestones divide the game's progression into major stages, and the full release will also use Milestones to mark major sections of progression. Unlike regular research, Milestones cannot be completed with Research Points. Instead, you must produce and collect the colors required by each Milestone through a Milestone Collector. events.title: Color Factory Demo v0.3.9 Update – Simplified Node Display When Zoomed Out
events.summary: Simplified Node Display When Zoomed Out As your factory grows and you use more nodes, it can become difficult to understand the overall layout and connections when zoomed out. With this update, when you zoom out beyond a certain level, nodes are now displayed as simplified icons so that the overall structure of your factory is easier to read. events.title: Color Factory Demo v0.3.1 Update – Windows Stability Improvements
events.summary: Color Factory Demo has been updated to v0.3.1!Windows Stability ImprovementsChanged the Windows graphics API to DirectX 11 to address an issue where the game could occasionally become unresponsive or crash on some systems.DirectX 11 is now enforced instead of DirectX 12 to improve overall stability.Thank you to everyone who reported the issue!
